title: Flash floods on Nepal-Tibet border leave scores dead and hundreds missing
summary_full: At least 157 people dead and hundreds of tourists among missing after roads, bridges and power plants swept awayNepal-Tibet flash floods – live updatesAt least 157 people have been killed and hundreds, including large numbers of foreign tourists, are missing after flash floods ⁠hit the Himalayan border areas of ⁠Nepal and Tibet in China, police have said, with parts of India also at risk.The disaster was caused by a torrent of mud, water and debris that burst from the banks of a river that runs between China and Nepal. Homes, roads, bridges and power plants were swept away in Nepal, ⁠while officials in Tibet said they feared “major casualties”. Continue reading...
